nodes.body: <<FILL role=setup words=75 beats='On the first snowy day of the year, Priya and her little brother Arjun finish one last ride down Maple Hill sled run. When Arjun climbs off the sled he has only one boot. His left snow boot is gone somewhere along the run and Mom is waiting for them at home for dinner. Priya decides where to start looking first.'>>

choices.label: Head up to the pine grove and snow fort
Head down to the frozen pond and toboggan track
Find a grownup to ask for help

nodes.body: <<FILL role=decision words=65 beats='Priya and Arjun climb back toward the top of Maple Hill where the ride began. Snow is falling harder now and the light is starting to fade. Near the top stand a cluster of tall pine trees and the snow fort the neighborhood kids built last weekend. Priya has to pick which spot to search first.'>>

choices.label: Search the pine grove
Search the snow fort

nodes.body: <<FILL role=decision words=65 beats='Priya and Arjun walk down toward the bottom of the run where the sled finally stopped. A frozen pond glitters at one edge of the hill and a separate toboggan track curves away to the side. Footprints and sled tracks crisscross everywhere in the fresh snow, making it hard to tell which way the missing boot might have gone.'>>

choices.label: Walk along the frozen pond
Check the toboggan track

nodes.body: <<FILL role=decision words=70 beats='Instead of searching alone, Priya decides it might be faster to ask a grownup who works at the hill. She spots three places where a helper might be: the ranger station by the parking lot, the ski patrol hut near the flag pole, and the lift operator booth at the base of the rope tow.'>>

choices.label: Go to the ranger station
Go to the ski patrol hut
Go to the lift operator booth

nodes.body: <<FILL role=explore words=70 beats='Under the tall pine trees, snow has piled into soft drifts. Priya and Arjun brush snow off a low branch and spot small dents in the ground that could be footprints, plus a bright red mitten caught on a twig that belongs to neither of them. Someone else has been through here recently.'>>

choices.label: Follow the small footprints
Ask around the grove for help

nodes.body: <<FILL role=explore words=70 beats='The snow fort has three walls and a lookout window packed by careful hands. Arjun climbs inside while Priya checks around the back wall where loose snow has been piled up. A trail of small footprints leads away from the fort toward the trees, and cocoa steam drifts on the wind from somewhere nearby.'>>

choices.label: Follow the footprints leading away
Follow the smell of cocoa

nodes.body: <<FILL role=explore words=70 beats='At the edge of the frozen pond, the ice glints under the falling snow. Priya keeps Arjun a safe distance from the water and they walk the snowy bank together. She spots a set of small footprints heading toward the lodge, and further off she can smell hot cocoa and hear voices from a stand near the trees.'>>

choices.label: Follow the footprints toward the lodge
Follow the smell of cocoa

nodes.body: <<FILL role=explore words=70 beats='The toboggan track is a separate, narrower lane worn smooth by dozens of riders. Priya and Arjun walk along its edge, checking the snowbanks on either side. Small footprints lead off toward a row of wooden buildings, and Priya notices a sign pointing toward more help further along the path.'>>

choices.label: Follow the footprints toward the buildings
Follow the sign toward more help

nodes.body: <<FILL role=explore words=70 beats='Inside the small wooden ranger station, a ranger named Mr Oso is warming his hands by a heater. Priya explains that Arjun lost his boot somewhere on the hill. Mr Oso mentions two places worth checking: a spot where returned gear gets sorted, and a hot cocoa stand where lost items sometimes turn up too.'>>

choices.label: Take Mr Osos tip about the rental desk
Take Mr Osos tip about the cocoa stand

nodes.body: <<FILL role=explore words=70 beats='The ski patrol hut smells like pine and warm coffee. A patroller named Dana listens carefully to Priyas story and nods. She suggests asking around near the hot cocoa stand, where a lot of families gather to warm up, or checking with a friend who spends every snowy afternoon on the hill.'>>

choices.label: Take Danas tip about the cocoa stand
Take Danas tip about asking around

nodes.body: <<FILL role=explore words=70 beats='At the lift operator booth, a friendly worker named Sam is bundled in a thick coat, watching riders line up for the rope tow. Sam remembers seeing a small footprint trail earlier and points Priya toward a wooden shed at one end of the hill and toward more help further along.'>>

choices.label: Follow Sams footprint tip
Follow Sams tip toward more help

nodes.body: <<FILL role=decision words=75 beats='No matter which trail led here, the small footprints all meet at the same spot near the middle of the hill. From here they split two ways: toward the old sled shed on one side, or toward the little bridge over the frozen creek on the other. Priya has to choose which way the boot is more likely to be.'>>

choices.label: Check the sled shed
Check the creek bridge

nodes.body: <<FILL role=decision words=70 beats='Every grownup and every clue seems to agree on one thing: someone nearby might know where the boot ended up. Priya decides whether to check the bin back at the lodge where found items get kept, or to look for a familiar face at the hot cocoa stand.'>>

choices.label: Check the lost and found bin
Check the hot cocoa stand

nodes.body: <<FILL role=decision words=70 beats='The trail of clues keeps circling back to the same warm, sweet smell of hot cocoa drifting from the trees. Priya and Arjun follow it toward a fork: the cocoa stand itself, or the ski rental desk just past it, where lost gear sometimes turns up.'>>

choices.label: Check the hot cocoa stand
Check the ski rental desk

nodes.body: <<FILL role=decision words=75 beats='Between the ranger, the ski patrol, the toboggan sign, and the lift operator, all the tips point toward the same two places: the ski rental desk, where returned gear gets sorted, or the lost and found bin back at the lodge.'>>

choices.label: Check the ski rental desk
Check the lost and found bin

nodes.body: <<FILL role=climax words=85 beats='Inside the creaky wooden sled shed, stacks of orange rental sleds lean against the walls. Priya and Arjun search carefully among the shelves, under the old workbench, and behind the stacked sleds, breathing puffs of cold air as they look for any sign of the missing boot.'>>

choices.label: Search the shelves
Search the workbench
Search behind the stacked sleds

nodes.body: <<FILL role=climax words=80 beats='Priya and Arjun cross the little wooden bridge over the frozen creek, snow crunching under their own remaining boots. On one side, a snowbank piles up against the railing. On the other, the water underneath makes a soft trickling sound beneath a thin layer of ice.'>>

choices.label: Check the snowbank by the railing
Check under the bridge

nodes.body: <<FILL role=climax words=85 beats='Back at the lodge, Mr Oso pulls out a big plastic bin marked LOST AND FOUND, filled with mittens, hats, and one lonely boot. Priya and Arjun dig through carefully while Mr Oso checks his clipboard for anything else turned in earlier that day.'>>

choices.label: Dig to the bottom of the bin
Ask about spare boots
Look right on top of the bin

nodes.body: <<FILL role=climax words=80 beats='Steam rises from the little hot cocoa stand where a vendor named Miss Tala is pouring cups for tired sledders. Priya scans the crowd for Mira while Arjun warms his hands, hoping someone nearby noticed a small snow boot along the run.'>>

choices.label: Look for Mira in the crowd
Warm up and wait a while

nodes.body: <<FILL role=climax words=80 beats='At the ski rental desk, a worker is sorting returned gear into neat piles at the end of the day. Priya asks if anyone turned in a single small snow boot, and the worker starts checking through a crate of items collected from around the hill.'>>

choices.label: Ask about spare boots
Ask the worker to check the crate

nodes.body: <<FILL role=ending words=65 beats='Tucked into the snowbank by the bridge railing, half buried but bright red against the white snow, Priya spots it: Arjuns missing boot. Arjun cheers and hops on one foot while Priya brushes off the snow. They pull it on together and head home just as the streetlights blink on, right on time for dinner.'>>

<<FILL role=ending words=65 beats='On the very top shelf of the sled shed, wedged between two old rental sleds, Priya finds a small, slightly muddy snow boot. It is dusty and a little squished, but it is definitely Arjuns. Arjun laughs at how silly it looks and pulls it on anyway, and they head home together, boots and all.'>>

<<FILL role=ending words=65 beats='Near the bottom of the lost and found bin, under a striped scarf, Priya finds a small snow boot that matches Arjuns other one perfectly. Someone had turned it in earlier that afternoon. Mr Oso smiles and writes it down on his clipboard, and Priya and Arjun head home with both boots back where they belong.'>>

<<FILL role=ending words=65 beats='The bin does not have the missing boot, but the worker remembers a family who left behind a nearly new pair of boots last week, just Arjuns size. Arjun tries them on and grins, wiggling his toes. They will look for the old boot again another day, but tonight he walks home warm and dry.'>>

<<FILL role=ending words=70 beats='Through the steam by the cocoa stand, Priya spots Mira waving with something tucked under her arm: Arjuns boot. Mira found it near the snow fort an hour ago and kept it safe, waiting to run into them. Arjun hugs the boot like a lost puppy, and the three friends walk back together, laughing about the whole snowy search.'>>

<<FILL role=ending words=65 beats='The workbench and shelves in the sled shed turn up nothing but old rope and spare mittens. Outside, the snow is falling faster and the sky is turning gray. Priya crouches down so Arjun can climb onto her back, and she carries him piggyback all the way home, both of them planning to search again tomorrow in daylight.'>>

<<FILL role=ending words=65 beats='Under the bridge, only ice and snow reflect back at them, no boot in sight. The daylight is fading fast and the first streetlamp flickers on above the trees. Priya takes Arjuns hand and they start the walk home, already planning to come back first thing tomorrow morning with Dad to search in the bright new light.'>>

<<FILL role=ending words=70 beats='Behind a stack of orange rental sleds, Priya finds not just Arjuns boot but also his missing striped mitten from last winter, both wedged into the same dusty corner. Arjun cannot believe his luck. They gather both treasures, pull the boot on tight, and walk home with a funny, wonderful story to tell at dinner.'>>

<<FILL role=ending words=65 beats='The moment Mr Oso lifts the lid of the lost and found bin, there it is, right on top: Arjuns small snow boot, placed there by a kind stranger only minutes before. Arjun squeals and pulls it on immediately. Priya thanks Mr Oso, and the two of them head home with plenty of time to spare before dinner.'>>
